fields.tables: One lookup table per rating factor; each adds one relativity column.
fields.tables[].factors: One to three input column names the table is keyed on, usually band columns from a Banding node.
fields.tables[].outputColumn: The relativity column the table adds; unique across the node.
fields.tables[].entries: One row per key combination: each factor column name with its value, written as the input column shows it ("17-24", "North"), plus a numeric "value".
fields.tables[].defaultValue: The value for a row whose key has no entry. Without it the node fails naming the missing key, unless onMissing is "neutral".
fields.tables[].onMissing: Optional: "error" (default) fails on a missing key with no default; "neutral" leaves it null and a combined output skips it.
fields.combinedOutputs: Optional combined columns over every table's output: {outputColumn, operation, baseValue}, operation "multiply", "add", "min" or "max", baseValue a finite number such as the base rate.
fields.steps: Optional post-rating step cards; df is already the rated frame, so there is no source step. Keep [] with nothing to do.
